_comment: Pins the objection-authorized decline channel where RFC-MACP-0012 4.1's schema_version-3 empty-tally rule and RFC-MACP-0007 6.2's finalize_decline meet: a non-'none' algorithm, zero decisive votes, and a standing critical objection. The tri-state gates only VOTE-authorized commitments; the decline here is authorized by the recorded critical Objection, so it seals even though the tally is empty and the decline guard is unsatisfiable. Companion to decision_critical_objection_finalize_decline.json, whose algorithm is 'none' and therefore never reaches the empty-tally rule.
description: Decision Mode: under schema_version 3 with a non-'none' algorithm and an empty tally, 'finalize_decline' still authorizes a negative commitment -- the decline is objection-authorized, not vote-authorized.

policy.description: Majority vote with a critical-objection veto that finalizes as a decline; schema_version 3 fail-closed empty-tally semantics.

messages._comment: Doubly blocked: the standing critical objection vetoes the positive direction, and under schema_version 3 the empty tally independently fails every algorithm other than 'none' (RFC-MACP-0012 4.1). Either ground alone suffices for POLICY_DENIED.

payload.reason: attempt to commit over a standing critical objection on an empty tally

messages._comment: THE DISCRIMINATOR. No vote was ever cast, so the decisive tally is empty and the decline guard of RFC-MACP-0007 6.2 is unsatisfiable -- a vote-authorized decline would be denied. This decline is OBJECTION-authorized under critical_objection_action 'finalize_decline': its authorization is the recorded critical Objection, it is not gated by the voting tri-state, and it seals the session negatively. A runtime that swallows finalize_decline into the empty-tally rule rejects this message and fails the fixture.

payload.reason: critical objection finalized as a decline on an empty tally
